grading_policy.missing_answers: Retain every scheduled failure or missing answer. Do not replace trials, zero-fill unknowns or select a favorable complete subset.
grading_policy.original_semantics: Unchanged q004 ten-unit facts, original source-grounded success and four core citation gates. No development answer enters this confirmation.
grading_policy.packets: Twenty exact final answers receive preassigned random opaque IDs and shuffled order; supply only unchanged question/rubric/contract and full frozen source. No profile, repeat/pair/run ID, trajectory, resource, prior grades or mapping to graders.
grading_policy.reporting: Show all raw trials, original scores and citation/core gates, original success, actual source/retrieval scope, complete reported usage and all score-tail exclusions. Model review is not official or human grading.
grading_policy.unblinding: Persist original independent grades and separate consistency judgments before private mapping read. Disclose reviewer reuse/exposure and parent condition-aware resource audits.

historical_evidence: q004 development run39375703707 and all earlier custom/native q001-q004 answers are excluded. Parent selected q004 confirmation after a successful development input-efficiency observation; it is a fixed-case confirmation, not an unseen or randomly selected holdout. No q005 solver is scheduled.

statistics.measurement_scope: Claude-reported per-model input including uncached, cache-read and cache-write; output separate, complete persisted root/child corroboration separate; no monetary-cost claim.
statistics.score_trimming: Exactly one minimum and one maximum score per task/profile; deterministic trial_index then original-position ties; use the same retained tuples for every resource metric.

stability_analysis.quality: An efficiency stability result alone does not establish an adequate-quality benchmark set; show absolute original quality-pass rates and each task core failures.
stability_analysis.scope: Descriptive repeatability for the single fixed zvec q004 question; no cross-task or population inference.
stability_analysis.strong_observed_efficiency_condition: On q004, in both raw10 and score-trimmed8 views: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for input reduction >0, score delta >=0, and original quality-pass-rate delta >=0. All scheduled execution/scope and reported-metric audits must pass. Absolute quality pass rates remain separate.
stability_analysis.time: Agent/native/full-slot time reductions and intervals are secondary. Do not infer total-time savings from input savings.
stability_analysis.variance_question: Compare raw/trimmed score sample SD, agent-time/input-token CV and paired bootstrap interval widths. Explicitly report metrics whose variability increases or remains unchanged.

statistics.task_screening: One fixed task is below the five-task guard: task-level MAD screening is unavailable; retain q004.
statistics.time_scope: Harbor agent_execution for PR-compatible variability screening; separately retain native run, fresh setup/index and outer-slot elapsed time over the same retained tuples.
statistics.unknown_or_invalid_evidence: Retain every scheduled execution and failure. Never replace unavailable quality or usage with zero or silently drop an invalid observation. Full statistical conclusions require the planned evidence to be available; otherwise report incomplete scope and missing counts.

stopping: Finish exactly ten new q004 pairs, baseline10 and zg10 scheduled; no favorable early stopping, CI reruns, trial retries, replacements or pooling historical/development answers. Each fresh hosted pair runs its two profiles serially, with balanced five/five order. Ten hosted pairs may run concurrently; every profile has fresh source/home/session/index state.
user_authorization: Active goal: prioritize zvec QA; human explicitly requested baseline10 and zg10 executions per task. This cohort performs only the q004 confirmation,20 new solver trials.
